name: DriftGuard AI
tagline: Catches when teams silently redefine the KPIs they all report on.
description: DriftGuard gives your organization a memory for what its numbers mean. After every meeting it extracts metrics and working definitions, compares them to a living glossary built from prior meetings, and flags definition drift, confounded value changes (when a metric 'improves' only because the definition moved), and cross-team conflicts. Returns a plain-language alert report plus an updated metric glossary — the single source of truth for what Activation, ARR, and every other number actually mean.
